reading.body:
Google does not publish megawatt capacity, square footage, or exact addresses for individual buildings at its Berkeley County campus, only aggregate investment figures at the state level. The facility is part of a long-running Google site in Moncks Corner that received a $500 million expansion announcement in 2024 alongside a combined $3.3 billion investment across two South Carolina campuses. Without published specifications for this campus, its contribution to Google's South Carolina footprint cannot be quantified.

South Carolina has 14 mapped data center facilities, but only 4 operators have published power capacity figures in the state. Those four operators report a combined 6.6 MW of disclosed capacity. This campus ranks fifth among mapped facilities in the state by published capacity, which means no published figure exists for it. The ranking reflects the number of facilities mapped in OpenStreetMap rather than any disclosed power metric.

The absence of building-level disclosure from Google at this site is consistent with its stated policy of publishing investment amounts at state level only. For readers assessing whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the published facts permit no reading of its power capacity, compute footprint, or water consumption. The scale of announced capital investment suggests material infrastructure, but without specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated against the compute-first thesis.
